title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
@cursor Part 2 of 5 for issue #4: Incremental DOM mutations.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #4, then do ONLY Part 2.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): order mutations and handle edge cases (#4)` with the tests and the smallest stubs so typecheck passes, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Process removes, adds, attributes, text in that order. Handle every edge case from Steps 4 of the issue.

Requirements:
- Add then remove in one batch produces nothing
- Moved node keeps its id
- Nested adds serialized once
- Repeated attribute keeps last value
- Explain the ordering in the PR note

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- One test per edge case

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): order mutations and handle edge cases (#4)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.

Push to the existing branch `day-04/dom-mutations`. Do not open a new PR. Do not change earlier parts unless needed to pass checks; say why if you do. Do not do any other part.
